test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Change the following sentence into the Active form.

The report, which should have been submitted by the deadline, was delayed due to unforeseen circumstances.

options.text: The report, which should have submitted by the deadline, was delayed due to unforeseen circumstances.
They should have submitted the report by the deadline, but it was delayed due to unforeseen circumstances.
Due to unforeseen circumstances, the report was delayed, which should have been submitted by the deadline.
They should have submitted the report by the deadline, but unforeseen circumstances delayed it.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. They should have submitted the report by the deadline, but unforeseen circumstances delayed it .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is written in the **passive voice**. To convert it into the **active voice**, the subject (the agent performing the action) must become explicit.
 
• In the passive sentence, the action is described as being performed, but the doer of the action is implied. The active voice specifies the doer directly.
 
• The sentence in active voice follows the structure: **Subject (doer) + verb (action) + object (receiver)**.

Correct sentence: *They should have submitted the report by the deadline, but unforeseen circumstances delayed it*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passive Voice:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Object + verb (in past participle) + subject (optional).
 
• **Example:** The book was read by her.
 
• **Usage:** Used when the focus is on the action or the receiver of the action rather than the doer.
 
 
 
• **Active Voice:**
 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + verb + object.
 
• **Example:** She read the book.
 
• **Usage:** Used when the focus is on the doer of the action.
